name: Kamisato Ayaka
title: Frostflake Heron
description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

skillTalents.name: Kamisato Art - Kabuki
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a flurry of sword ki.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging enemies along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Kamisato Art: Hyouka
skillTalents.description:
Summons blooming ice to launch nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

"Clouds shroud the moonlit night. Longing descends like a fog, filling the one detained with wanderlust."

skillTalents.name: Kamisato Art: Soumetsu
skillTalents.description:
Summons forth a snowstorm with flawless poise, unleashing a Frostflake Seki no To that moves forward continuously.

Frostflake Seki no To
·A storm of whirling icy winds that slashes repeatedly at every enemy it touches, dealing Cryo DMG.
·The snowstorm explodes after its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

"The blizzard veils the heron's thoughts, pity heavy in its heart."

One storm performs 19 cuts and 1 final bloom. Cutting coefficients are per hit; the number of hits on each target depends on contact with the storm.

upgrades.name: Cutting DMG — up to 19 cuts per storm

skillTalents.name: Kamisato Art: Senho
skillTalents.description:
Alternate Sprint
Ayaka consumes Stamina and cloaks herself in a frozen fog that moves with her.

In Senho form, she moves swiftly upon water.
When she reappears, the following effects occur:
·Ayaka unleashes frigid energy to apply Cryo on nearby opponents.
·Coldness condenses around Ayaka's blade, infusing her attacks with Cryo for a brief period.

"Feathers fleeting wet / the white heron treads water / a sight without flaw"

passiveTalents.name: Amatsumi Kunitsumi Sanctification
passiveTalents.description: After using Kamisato Art: Hyouka, Kamisato Ayaka's Normal and Charged Attacks deal 30% increased DMG for 6s.

modifiers.label: Ayaka Normal Attack DMG for 6s after Kamisato Art: Hyouka
Ayaka Charged Attack DMG for 6s after Kamisato Art: Hyouka

passiveTalents.name: Kanten Senmyou Blessing
passiveTalents.description:
When the Cryo application at the end of Kamisato Art: Senho hits an opponent, Kamisato Ayaka gains the following effects:
·Restores 10 Stamina
·Gains 18% Cryo DMG Bonus for 10s.

modifiers.label: Ayaka Cryo DMG Bonus for 10s when the Cryo application at the end of Senho hits an opponent

passiveTalents.name: Fruits of Shinsa
passiveTalents.description: When Ayaka crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

constellations.name: Snowswept Sakura
constellations.description: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal Cryo DMG to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.

constellations.name: Blizzard Blade Seki no To
constellations.description:
When casting Kamisato Art: Soumetsu, unleashes 2 smaller additional Frostflake Seki no To, each dealing 20% of the original storm's DMG.

Each of the 2 additional storms has its own cutting sequence and final bloom. The coefficients below are per cut and per bloom of one additional storm, using the effective level of Kamisato Art: Soumetsu.

skills.label: One cutting hit of each additional C2 storm — 20% of the original; values by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu levels 1–15
Final bloom of each additional C2 storm — 20% of the original; values by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu levels 1–15

constellations.name: Frostbloom Kamifubuki
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Soumetsu by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Ebb and Flow
constellations.description: Opponents damaged by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu's Frostflake Seki no To will have their DEF decreased by 30% for 6s.

modifiers.label: DEF reduction of opponents damaged by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu Frostflake Seki no To for 6s

constellations.name: Blossom Cloud Irutsuki
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Dance of Suigetsu
constellations.description: Kamisato Ayaka gains Usurahi Butou every 10s, increasing her Charged Attack DMG by 298%. This buff will be cleared 0.5s after Ayaka's Charged ATK hits an opponent, after which the timer for this ability will restart.

modifiers.label: Ayaka Charged Attack DMG during Usurahi Butou; cleared 0.5s after a hit, available every 10s

outfits.name: Springbloom Missive
outfits.description: Ayaka's travel outfit. Its design is based on the Fontaine dresses depicted in light novel illustrations and seems to reflect the lifestyle of proper ladies who live in that nation.
